description_en: Creates a cache disk for a gateway
description_zh: 在网关下创建一个缓存盘
name: CreateGatewayCacheDisk

parameters.help_en: The type of the cache disk. Only Enhanced SSDs (ESSDs) are supported. Set the value to cloud_essd
parameters.help_zh: 缓存盘的类型。仅支持ESSD云盘，取值为cloud_essd
parameters.name: cache_disk_category

parameters.help_en:
The capacity of the cache disk in GB. The capacity must meet the following requirements:

For a basic gateway, the capacity must be in the range of 40 GB to 4,096 GB.

For a standard gateway, the capacity must be in the range of 40 GB to 8,192 GB.

For an enhanced or performance-optimized gateway, the capacity must be in the range of 40 GB to 32,768 GB.

If CacheDiskCategory is set to cloud_essd and PerformanceLevel is set to PL2, the minimum capacity is 461 GB.

If CacheDiskCategory is set to cloud_essd and PerformanceLevel is set to PL3, the minimum capacity is 1,261 GB
parameters.help_zh:
缓存盘的容量大小。单位：GB。缓存盘容量要求：
基础型网关缓存盘容量区间为40 GB~4096 GB。
标准型网关缓存盘容量区间为40 GB~8192 GB。
增强型和性能型网关缓存盘容量区间为40 GB~32768 GB。
当CacheDiskCategory取值为cloud_essd且PerformanceLevel取值为PL2时，缓存盘容量下限为461 GB。
当CacheDiskCategory取值为cloud_essd且PerformanceLevel取值为PL3时，缓存盘容量下限为1261 GB
parameters.name: cache_disk_size_in_gb

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the ESSD. This parameter is required if CacheDiskCategory is set to cloud_essd. Valid values:

PL1

PL2

PL3
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD云盘性能等级。当CacheDiskCategory取值为cloud_essd时需要传入此参数。取值范围：
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.name: performance_level

BuyURL.description_en: The purchase URL. This parameter is returned for subscription gateways
BuyURL.description_zh: 预付费情况下, 售卖链接

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the task that is used to create the cache disk. This parameter is returned for pay-as-you-go gateways
TaskId.description_zh: 按量付费情况下，创建缓存盘的任务ID
